question: What are the primary target sectors and geographic regions targeted by the Salt Typhoon threat actor across these reports?
answer:
- Primary Target Sectors:
  • Telecommunications providers (including backbone, edge routers and ISPs)
  • Government networks and agencies (federal and state units)
  • Transportation infrastructure
  • Lodging and hospitality networks
  • Military networks (e.g., National Guard)

- Primary Geographic Regions:
  • United States (major focus on carriers, National Guard and cable/broadband ISPs)
  • Canada
  • United Kingdom
  • Australia
  • New Zealand
  • Broad global impact, affecting hundreds of organizations in over 80 countries
